gloss: to sell off; to dispose of by selling

definitions.gloss: to sell off; to sell out; to dispose of (a large quantity) by selling
definitions.explanation: To sell goods—often a large quantity, leftover stock, or illicitly obtained items—until they are gone. Implies skillful or aggressive distribution, and is frequently used for clearing inventory or fencing stolen items.

examples.japanese: ⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{売|う}りさばいた。
⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{盗品|とうひん}→盗品：28317_touhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{売|う}りさばいて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The perpetrator was selling stolen goods online.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{仕入|しい}れた→仕入れる：11430_shiireru⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{短期間|たんきかん}→短期間：17178_tankikan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{売|う}りさばいて⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げた→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
examples.english: We made a profit by selling off cheaply procured goods in a short period.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧ (to sell) + さばく (to handle, dispose of, work through). The さばく element conveys efficiency and completeness — selling through everything.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. Takes a direct object marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{売|う}りさばく.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{売|う}りさばく: to sell off inventory
- ⟦{盗品|とうひん}→盗品：28317_touhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{売|う}りさばく: to fence stolen goods
- ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{売|う}りさばく: to dispose of merchandise by selling
- ⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧{売|う}りさばく: to sell off cheaply

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧: to sell — neutral, no nuance of clearing or volume
- ⟦{売|う}り→売る：00906_uru⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to sell out — completion focus, often by seller's effort
- ⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dispose of — broader, includes discarding, not just selling
